entries.title: Material discrepancies and limits
entries.summary: ## Material discrepancies and limits 1. **Closed is not sold.** The Complete ZIP README describes 128 closed results as sold, but every `isSold` field in those 128 rows is blank. Forty-five reserve-met observations do not prove completed sales.

entries.title: How the materials fit together
entries.summary: ## How the materials fit together The atlas supplies a broad source registry and proposed acquisition/validation framework. The ServiceLink archives supply one concrete captured source dataset and media collection. The PDF explains the author's understanding of how that source operates.
